releases.name: Exit Ways
releases.summary: Exit Ways is a PvEvP survival extraction shooter. Grow your community in a zombie apocalypse. Rescue survivors, craft gear and build a base.

releases.name: Discremental
releases.summary: Discremental is a short idle and incremental game where you primarily upgrade your disk, along with other equipment.

releases.name: Dealer's Dice
releases.summary: Dealer's Dice is a high-stakes dice defense game engineered for true gamblers. Collect powerful dice, manage your betting table, and test your luck against an endless onslaught. Will you play it safe, or push your luck for the ultimate jackpot? Remember, you only have one life.

releases.name: YiJing 101
releases.summary: *****Top Biking Action*****Mad Mountain Trails moves to the Amazon JungleBeautifully updated graphics and soundThis is an awesome game that will keep you busy for hours. Do you like mountain bikes, Motocross, Enduro Trails, Freestyling?This is the game for you! You can forward flip your bike more times than Travis Pastrana – the multi winner of X-Games Freestyle Motocross.Fun for kids and the whole family!Features include:• 25 challenging levels• Race the clock• 5 in the air tricks for additional points• Gather as many bike coins for additional points• 5 characters to choose from (1 Mountain Bike Man, 1 Mountain Bike Woman, Three Dirt Bikes.• Power boosts to help you get through the challenging level• Level Skips – when you just can’t get past that difficult oneTo get speed, simply press and hold your finger on the screen when going down hill and release going up. It may sound easy, but you need to have a strategy to make it down the hill before time runs out.We love feedback to help improve the game. So let us know by email to trinapps@icloud.comHave fun!

releases.name: Shelf Happens
releases.summary: You (alone or with friends) need to place scattered movie tapes on the right genre shelves in a retro video store . Complete shelves and earn XP to unlock abilities that improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to sort hundreds of tapes by genre fast!

releases.name: Tombstone Showdown
releases.summary: Saddle up for Tombstone Showdown, an online multiplayer trivia game where quick thinking rules the West! Challenge your posse across thousands of questions, choose your categories and difficulty, and race to prove who's the sharpest mind in Tombstone.

releases.name: Crazy Pocket
releases.summary: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!

releases.name: PLUG IN
releases.summary: Observe and experiment on containment subjects. PLUG IN is a simple yet skillful sokoban puzzle game. Carefully guide the anomalies through complex test chambers, ensuring they complete their designated trajectories and ultimately fulfill the observation objectives.

releases.name: KKUL-TTEOK!
releases.summary: You're a honey rice cake. Team up with up to 4 players, cheer each other on, and survive the mouth and esophagus before you're digested.
